class.name: SteamProvider
class.brief_description: Uses the signed-in Steam client for online games, verified peer identity, and native Steam transport.

method.name: with_message_channels
method.description: Returns an independent provider branch allowing the specified app message channels for verified, world-ready Steam Game peers. Supply at most 16 distinct channel names of up to 32 ASCII characters, or an empty list to disable Game Messages. Invalid names return null.

method.name: configure
method.description: Build detached settings with a private lobby and the Steam launch AppID.

method.name: for_app
method.description: Return a branch with this expected AppID. Zero uses the Steam launch AppID, and invalid IDs return null.

method.name: private
method.description: Return a branch that publishes an invite-only lobby.

method.name: friends_only
method.description: Return a branch that publishes a lobby joinable by friends and invitees.

method.name: public_lobbies
method.description: Return a branch whose compatible lobby appears in Steam search.

method.name: invisible_lobby
method.description: Return a branch whose lobby appears in Steam search and is hidden from friends visibility.

method.name: with_lobby_namespace
method.description: Return a branch with 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. An invalid namespace returns null.

method.name: on_virtual_port
method.description: Return a branch with a Steam virtual port from 0 to 65535. An invalid port returns null.

method.name: prefer_relay
method.description: Returns a branch that prefers Valve relay routes over direct ICE for incoming Steam listen connections. It adds a 500 millisecond ICE route selection penalty while preserving direct fallback. Dedicated routes are unaffected. Observe the actual chosen path with [method SteamNetworking.peer_path].

method.name: set_prefer_relay_routes
method.description: Sets the route preference for the next Steam listen attachment.

method.name: get_prefer_relay_routes
method.description: Returns whether the next Steam listen attachment will prefer Valve relays.

method.name: set_lobby_visibility
method.description: Set the lobby visibility captured when the game attaches.

method.name: get_lobby_visibility
method.description: Return the configured Steam lobby visibility.

method.name: set_app_id
method.description: Set the expected AppID before attaching the game.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Return the configured expected AppID.

method.name: set_virtual_port
method.description: Set the Steam P2P virtual port before attaching the game.

method.name: get_virtual_port
method.description: Return the configured Steam P2P virtual port.

method.name: set_lobby_namespace
method.description: Set the shared lobby namespace before attaching the game.

method.name: get_lobby_namespace
method.description: Return the configured namespace.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Return whether this Resource identifies one attached game with usable Steam. Use [method SteamServices.for_game] when the Resource is shared.

method.name: get_local_steam_id
method.description: Return the signed-in SteamID64 for the uniquely identified attachment, or an empty string.

method.name: get_initialization_error
method.description: Return the unique attachment's startup diagnostic or the diagnostic for an ambiguous Resource.

method.name: open_invite_overlay
method.description: Request the invite picker for the uniquely attached game's current lobby. Use [method GameInvites.open_overlay] for an exact game attachment.

method.name: invite_player
method.description: Send an invitation from the uniquely attached game's current lobby. Use [method GameInvites.send] for an exact game attachment.

method.name: with_commerce_backend
method.description: Returns a new provider configuration with the selected game-owned commerce adapter. The adapter must use the game's authenticated purchasing backend. Pass null for a provider without commerce.

method.name: dedicated
method.description: Return a branch that creates a separate SteamGameServer pipe for [method GameRuntime.start_dedicated_online]. The game remains playerless and does not acquire a signed-in Steam client. Null settings return null.

method.name: with_relay_coordinator
method.description: Return a branch with the trusted hosted relay coordinator. The server uses registration and withdrawal. The signed-in guest uses fresh authorization. Null clears the adapter for a future Game.

members.member: Bias Steam listen-host route selection toward Valve relays. Direct ICE remains a fallback. The default uses Steam's normal route scoring. Dedicated sessions select their own route.
Expected Steam AppID for this game. Zero accepts the AppID selected by Steam when the process starts. Configure the provider before attaching the game.
Steam P2P virtual port used by the host, from 0 to 65535. Zero is the standard Steam P2P port. This value is independent of the direct UDP port.
Game-specific identifier checked when joining a Steam lobby. Use the same value on host and guests. Use 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.
Who can discover and join the hosted Steam lobby. Private requires a Steam invitation.

signal.name: invite_received
signal.description: Emitted when Steam asks the running client to join a lobby. Submit the listing to [method GameRuntime.join_online] after the user accepts it in your game.

constants.constant: Joinable by Steam friends and invitees.
Appears in compatible Steam lobby search.
Appears in Steam search while hidden from friends visibility.
